title: #124 golden never exercises the new streak-refill arm — its recovery runs on the pre-existing all-clear path
detail: The golden named as the #124 story heals via the unchanged all-clear branch (breach exits first). The streak-gated refill arm never fires in any golden: in-grace the meter sits at 100 (meter<100 gate dead), and drain ticks reset the streak.
recommended_fix: Extend the demo (or add a sibling golden) holding a class breach-latched-in-grace with the meter below 100 for 200+ ticks so the streak arm visibly drives the heal; or state in the PR that only unit tests exercise the arm.

title: health_recover.dem misdescribes its own timeline: fix lands at 40.0 s, drain starts ~49.2 s — not mid-drain
evidence:
demos/health_recover.dem:3-7: "the player FIGHTS BACK inside the drain: the streaming breach enters at ~84
# (the D-2 first-delivery lag); the grace (900) expires at ~984 and the meter
# drains 2/tick. The fix — demolish the narrows, place a second router
# (clears the 5.6 separation; every wide span <= 18), 2 wides per leg (the
# health_apply_fix shape) — lands at 40 s;" || demos/health_recover.dem:27: "at 40000ms demolish pipe 0" || spec line 51: "narrow-path saturation → Grace_Expired → meter mid-drain → demolish+wide-fan fix"
detail: The demo's own at-commands put the fix ~9 s before the first drain tick, inverting the frozen spec Code Map sequence ('Grace_Expired → meter mid-drain → demolish+wide-fan fix'); the PR body repeats the false 'fights back mid-drain' claim.
recommended_fix: Re-time the demolish/wide commands past ~49.2 s to match the prescribed mid-drain sequence, or correct the header and PR wording to 'fixed inside the grace; trough at the latch's exit'.

title: Contradictory grace-expiry comments in the new refill test (~400 vs ~330)
evidence: core/health_test.odin:574: "expires ~400 and the drain resumes — refill and drain never coexist." || core/health_test.odin:608: "// the grace then expires under the sustained breach (~330): the drain"
detail: The crafted grace (300 ticks, set at tick ~100) expires at ~tick 400; line 608's '~330' contradicts line 574 and the arithmetic. Comment-only; the tested behavior is correct.
recommended_fix: Change '~330' to '~400' in the line-608 comment.

title: health_lose.dem header keeps stale '(0.25 s)' beside the re-pinned breach at ~tick 84
evidence: demos/health_lose.dem:5: "# breaches at ~tick 84 (0.25 s — the D-2 first-delivery lag). The streaming"
detail: 84 ticks at 20 Hz is 4.2 s, not 0.25 s; the parenthetical survived from the old header ('~tick 5 (0.25 s)'). A measured-claims golden header misstates its own time scale.
recommended_fix: Replace '(0.25 s' with '(4.2 s' or drop the parenthetical in the header.

title: #115 citation mismatch: the filed issue is the HUD-signifiers report, not the lose-state guard
evidence: _pr_body_funfix.md:41: "## Lose-state tension is preserved (#115 does not regress)" || issue-115.md title: "[PLAYTEST-UX] Core HUD signifiers undefined in-game: POOL, red !! rings, tier-vs-lane colors, the E/S/B third lane" || docs/playtests/2026-08-31-neweyes.md: "the health meter never left 100 and the advertised lose state (\"Error 404\") was never reached" (marked '#115 adjacent')
